scope: Candidate Fedora compatibility libraries for the pinned Symbiont runtime; signed discovery only, no installation or OS qualification
notes: Actual original-base ldd and CLI loading found missing libssl.so.3 and libcrypto.so.3; all eight probe containers were removed
Fedora lists openssl3-libs as the OpenSSL 3 compatibility provider: https://packages.fedoraproject.org/pkgs/openssl3/openssl3-libs/fedora-45-updates.html
Resolve only the already-reviewed Fedora 45 release/updates repositories, then verify every candidate signature and pin exact bytes before a separate offline installation
Preserve the base OpenSSL 4 libraries and every installed package identity; no Ubuntu libraries, source change or new Cargo feature
